name: Product HQ
tagline: Strategy, discovery and a RICE-ranked roadmap that checks itself.
description:
A complete operating system for a product team, shown through a worked example: Lumen, a fictional analytics product planning its next quarter. Strategy sits at the top (vision, OKRs, personas), customer evidence underneath it (a feedback database and interview notes), and a roadmap ranked by RICE that you can see as a board, a timeline, a ranked table or an impact-versus-effort matrix.

The roadmap checks itself. A Reality check view shows whether Now and Next fit each team's capacity, which initiatives no customer asked for and no objective needs, and how often your confident bets came true last quarter, so your next RICE scores are more honest. Key results live in a scorecard with a one-click weekly check-in and a pace forecast to the end of the quarter.

Delivery pages turn the roadmap into shipped work: a filled-in PRD, a launch plan and release notes, plus blank templates to duplicate. Five AI recipes draft PRDs, write the Monday status digest, triage feedback, run a pre-mortem on an initiative and help you say no to a request kindly.
overview: Product team workspace: vision, OKRs with a live scorecard, a customer feedback database, a RICE-ranked roadmap (board, timeline, matrix, reality check), PRDs, launch plans, release notes and a weekly review.
